question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

RMTS, WGAK, BAHC, GUOU, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First letter → (5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (6) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (7) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (8) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bae265de4cf3c39b71f5b7ca59577d4eead931dadca294ec8c36c65b91cc1a3c.png] ​

Hence, "**LOVM**" is the correct answer.
